data.body: Converted to epic for /dso:brainstorm decomposition. Scope per the filer's note ('implementation deferred to a remediation sprint'): new JSON dispatch manifest written at Phase E; pre-harvest verification at Phase F that asserts each sub-agent's commits landed on the expected branch; helper script; tests. Distinct failure mode from bug 85f3 (which I just closed) — 85f3 addressed trailered direct-to-session bypass; 9679 addresses untrailered cross-pollution that the trailer-based leakage detector cannot catch.
